verdict.rationale: LangSmith mentions 'LangSmith Engine' which can automatically detect recurring issues in traces, diagnose root causes, and resolve them — a glimpse of an in-product AI agent handling tasks — but this is a single narrow mention focused on trace triage, not a general-purpose in-product assistant for delegating arbitrary tasks. Missing for 10: a documented conversational/chat-based assistant UI, broader task types delegable to it, and independent/hands-on confirmation it works as described.
